newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares roar ahead, more gains on horizon.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares roar ahead, more gains on horizon.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Monday after a day of solid rises bolstered by Dow Jones' advances, a strong dollar and climbing bonds with dealers seeing more gains ahead in a positive, upwardly surging market.
"There is liquidity in the market for more rises and the KFX index to reach new record heights," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 1.15 point to close at 130.19. The KFX December future rose 1.30 point to 130.00 with 256 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Carlsberg was in focus for its 1995/96 result, which was more or less as expected, the share closing seven down at 375.
Otherwise Den Danske Bank soared to a new record of 446, nine crowns higher than the start, while rival Unidanmark put on four crowns to hit 290.

Novo Nordisk had a good day too, finishing 25 crowns up to end at 1065 and Sophus Berendsen regained 22 crowns to close at 735, recovering a little after last week's downward adjustment of the wholesale group's whole year 1996 expectations.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.208 billion crowns.
